selected_primary_idea.title: CURA-Turb: Conditional Universality and Regime Audit for Turbulence
selected_primary_idea.summary: A typed-claim, scale-window, and regime-card protocol that distinguishes exact conditional relations from empirical universality and intermittency-modified statistics.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Statistical invariance claims for incompressible turbulent velocity fields across idealized and engineering-relevant regimes
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Classifying claim type and requiring regime/estimator audits makes turbulence comparisons more reproducible than an exponent-only or PDF-collapse-only criterion.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Create typed invariance dossiers, matched regime cards, predeclared scale windows, and conditional outcome labels before analysis.
falsifiers: exact law reported outside stated assumptions
pooled cross-flow claim without transfer bridge

competitive_ideas.title: Four-fifths residual benchmark
competitive_ideas.reason: A strong exact-law control but too narrow for broad statistical invariance.

high_risk_ideas.title: Universal turbulence embedding
high_risk_ideas.reason: Could hide regime, scale, and estimator dependence inside a learned representation.

rejected_ideas.title: One-number universality index
rejected_ideas.reason: No assumptions, physical scope, or falsification route.
